title: Amazon API Gateway to Amazon DynamoDB which streams event to AWS Lambda
description: API Gateway to DynamoDB to Lambda function using streams.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon API Gateway API integration with Amazon DynamoDB. It deploys a Lambda function as a consumer for the DynamoDB stream.
The Lambda function logs the decoded message which was received from the DynamoDB stream.
